heading: Examination-in-chief.
text:
The examination of witness by the party who calls him shall be called his examination-in-chief.
Cross-examination.––The examination of a witness by the adverse party shall be called his cross- examination.
Re-examination.––The examination of a witness, subsequent to the cross-examination by the party who called him, shall be called his re-examination.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
